description: This file implements a configuration flag handler for ADB (Android Debug Bridge) settings within the Cuttlefish project. It defines the AdbConfigFlagImpl class that manages command-line flags related to ADB modes, processes flag inputs, and generates help XML. It also sets default modes and logs when ADB is not enabled.

classes.name: AdbConfigFlagImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AdbConfigFlag interface, managing ADB mode flags, processing command-line arguments, and generating help XML.

methods.name: AdbConfigFlagImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ADB mode flag and sets up getter and setter logic for the flag.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the flag implementation.

methods.name: Dependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies of this flag feature, specifically the associated config_flag_.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes command-line arguments to set ADB modes and connection settings, with default initialization and logging.

methods.name: WriteGflagsCompatHelpXml
methods.description: Generates XML help documentation for the flags.
